storyLead: Our family has been part of the concrete construction industry for more than 50 years. Wall Concrete and Construction is family owned and family run, and we consider our employees, and the businesses we work with and for, part of that family.
story: Today we have more than 50 full-time employees. Our crew leads and about half of our team have more than 10 years of concrete experience, and they’ve worked together that whole time. Our employees are our greatest asset. We take pride in every project and adapt our services to each customer’s needs.

Over the years we’ve taken on virtually every type of concrete construction: industrial plants, coal mines, material handling facilities, waste disposal sites, national parks, and federal and state highways. We perform bridge deck and barrier repair, and we build water tanks, water and sewer treatment plants, large compressor sites and power plants. When a project calls for it, we act as the general contractor, backed by a team of contractors we’ve worked with successfully for years.

Our skills range from heavy formwork to large industrial slabs and complex industrial plants. We’ve met hard deadlines on overhauls that ran 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, working alongside owners, engineers, general contractors and every kind of safety program. We’re licensed in the State of Utah (B100 & E100), and references are available on request.
mission: We work *safe, smart and hard* to help our customers succeed.
